def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):

    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

lib = '''
def background(grid):
    """The most common cell value in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def components(grid, bg=None):
    """All 4-connected components of non-background cells, as lists of (row, col); bg defaults to the most common value."""
    from collections import deque
    if bg is None: bg = background(grid)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, comps = set(), []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] != bg and (i, j) not in seen:
                q, comp = deque([(i, j)]), []
                seen.add((i, j))
                while q:
                    a, b = q.popleft(); comp.append((a, b))
                    for da, db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x, y = a+da, b+db
                        if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] != bg and (x, y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x, y)); q.append((x, y))
                comps.append(comp)
    return comps

def blank_like(grid):
    """A copy of the grid with every cell set to 0."""
    return [[0]*len(r) for r in grid]

def stamp_template(grid):
    """Stamp the largest non-background shape (the template, centered) onto every other non-background cell (marker)."""
    g = grid
    bg = background(g)
    comps = components(g, bg)
    tmpl = max(comps, key=len)
    rs = [a for a, b in tmpl]; cs = [b for a, b in tmpl]
    r0, c0 = min(rs), min(cs)
    ar = (min(rs)+max(rs))//2 - r0
    ac = (min(cs)+max(cs))//2 - c0
    tvals = {(a-r0, b-c0): g[a][b] for a, b in tmpl}
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for comp in comps:
        if comp is tmpl:
            continue
        a, b = comp[0]
        for (dr, dc), v in tvals.items():
            x, y = a-ar+dr, b-ac+dc
            if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w:
                out[x][y] = v
    return out
'''
